title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A website designed to help users solve ACM-style competitive programming problems.

features.name: Problem Library
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Editor
features.description: An integrated code editor with support for multiple programming languages.

features.name: Online Judge
features.description: An automated system to evaluate and provide feedback on submitted solutions.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Profiles for users to track their progress, achievements, and rankings.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: A leaderboard to display top-performing users based on problem-solving performance.

constraints: Requires a scalable backend for handling submissions
target_users: Competitive programming enthusiasts, students, and professionals preparing for ACM contests
data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, and solution submissions
